verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB ships a first-party MCP integration so coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, VS Code, Zed) can list services, run SQL and read monitoring through OAuth. That lets users operate parts of the product in natural language, but only through an external agent; there is no evidence of a native natural-language interface in the product itself. CHKit's typed commands are agent-drivable, but they are structured commands rather than natural-language ones. Missing for 10: a native in-product natural-language or text-to-SQL interface, natural-language coverage of management operations beyond the listed MCP tools (e.g. scaling, backups, access control), and hands-on or independent corroboration.
